content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NHM Mumbai Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 31 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Medical Health Officer posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 28 vacancies announced for the Medical Health Officer posts in NHM Mumbai Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility criteria for these posts?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria require candidates to be officers from an equivalent cadre in the Public Health Department.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for NHM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for these positions through email by sending their application and documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Medical Health Officer posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered is S-25 for Deputy Director and S-23 for Assistant Director posts.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NHM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection process steps?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by the creation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation.

faq.question: Q9. Which city is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for positions located in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article.
